description:
List a store's orders, newest first. Statuses: pending (awaiting payment), paid (seen on chain, confirming), confirmed (items granted, receipt issued), expired, refunded. A stray or duplicate payment never changes an order; it shows up as an order.mismatch / order.duplicate_payment event (iap_list_events). Store key scope: orders:read.

Params: store_id, status?, wallet?, cursor?, limit?, session_token?
Returns: {entries: Order[], nextCursor}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_list_orders
title: List store orders
